index_scope.includes: recording, worker, native SNP/index, runtime job; excludes supervisors and outer controls

audit_scope.local: shared stage/evaluator validation plus direct numeric counts, finite actions, hashes and exact own/sham pose/next_pose/action/input/output arrays; no neural recomputation
audit_scope.root_raw: shared stage-lineage guards plus independent 4626 rows, policy bindings, 40 SNPs, 16 strict core boundaries, inputs/identity and terminal process proof
audit_scope.root_outcomes: independent raw occupancy/gold, selection/inspection/timing/task and trajectory checks across all36 conditions

limitations: Four new development cells only; remaining36 full-matrix cells and held-out scope open.
All nine conditions share fixed lower route; only four core conditions are strict U-only, other five retain declared configuration/resources.
Both nulls produce false targets for own/sham and five other selectors; confirmations are not stale-value corrections.
Upper changed fact is observed and passively corrected at300 in every condition; no own-U timing/task benefit.
Source acquisition is explicitly privileged manual supervision; continuations are actual fixed CPU FLYNN policy.act.
No biological-learning, operator-blindness, held-out or R2-completion claim.
